falsification: Any eligible well has different latest-record and segment-end anchors/windows, or the frozen template/cohort contract fails.

rules.target_start: latest eligible record month plus one
rules.current_history_cutoff: latest segment end minus one month
rules.sensitivity_history_cutoff: latest segment start minus one month

new_checks: event interpretation observational equivalence on all declared history wells
calendar cutoff differences in frozen complete training and test cohorts

runtime.raw_access: authorized local declared CSV sources, read-only

stopping: Missing/deviant cohort, duplicate well-month, invalid month, missing template alignment: stop.

Keep formal deployment and A2B-017 stop decisions unchanged.
report: Anonymous counts and validation booleans only. No well IDs, raw rows, row-level targets/predictions, or private event values.
rollback: Stop using these new audit documents; keep existing B artifacts and raw data unchanged.
